description: A support ticket inbox with Open, Pending, Solved and All queues, a ticket view and a reply box.
overview: A help desk screen built on `SplitView`, with a sidebar of queues, a list of tickets showing the requester `Avatar`, priority and device, and a detail view. In the detail view a `ToggleGroup` changes the ticket status, a `Textarea` takes a reply, Send and set pending sends it and moves the ticket to Pending, and Mark as solved closes it.
usage: Replace `INITIAL_TICKETS` with your tickets. Wire `onViewChange`, `onStatusChange` and `onReply` to your help desk backend; the screen also updates its own ticket list.
